proves: RFC 0008 forbids effects inside migrations ('Migrations are pure... Forbidding perform...'); the real compiler accepts `state => { perform IO.print(42) }` (no purity/effect check on migration bodies in src/typechecker.rs or src/effect_checker.rs), and the 42 is never printed because the whole migration contract is dropped at MIR lowering — observable proof the body compiles to no code.
